snippet.title: Void Reaver - Demo Trailer - Inventory Management Roguelike Game
snippet.description:
VOID REAVER
🎮 When inventory management meets Bullet Heaven

In this sci-fi roguelite:
👉 Your backpack is your build
👉 Every item placement matters
👉 Rearranging your inventory unlocks game-breaking synergies

Wishlist on Steam @ Void Reaver 

A word from the studio : "It's finally time ! Our first game demo as Banana Blitz Studio is now available for the Steam Next Fest, you can already play a bit of the game, and if you like it and want to support us, please add it to your wishlist 😃

@nib​ana will be in charge of the art direction as well the full soundtrack including collaborations with amazing musicians: Ajja, LunaRave and Yoan Richard (for their new project Analog Anxiety). 

The game will include an full album worth of music (12 tracks-ish) spanning from Downtempo to more Upbeat tones that will also be available as a standalone download.

The Early Access will come towards June, and the full game hopefully at the end of this year.

We hope you'll like it 😃
